summary: The imported description does not match the original fix. ArrayVec::insert previously accepted indices greater than len but below capacity, allowing len - index to underflow during element shifting. The fix rejects these indices by returning Some(element) without modifying the vector, while preserving valid append insertion. The fix-added test_insert_out_of_bounds in tests/tests.rs inserts at index 1 into an empty vector with capacity 8 and checks rejection. No tests were run.
